iss.version: NASA IGOAL D · export PNG compatible
iss.note: Full IGOAL assembly: original compressed geometry and original lossless PNG textures. Opaque cutouts use depth-tested alpha masks; Cupola glass retains blending. Uniform white COLOR_0 layers audited and omitted. Body axes calibrated in scene/world coordinates: Node1 to Node2 is source -X, Node3 to Cupola is source -Y. Nominal LVLH only, not live measured attitude. Solar wings use a neutral deployed baseline. Runtime Sun tracking animates two shared SARJ alpha joints plus eight independent beta joints using the real carrier hierarchy; central modules and Cupola remain fixed. iROSA mounts retain their designed relative inclination. No live motor telemetry or dated parking modes are implied. The final body-Y reflection corrects the mirrored source assembly and restores readable NASA/ESA lettering without reversing nadir or forward axes.
